data.subject: Dark mode for dashboard
data.body: Our team works late shifts and the bright white dashboard is really straining their eyes. We've had multiple team members request dark mode. This is becoming a blocker for our night shift operations team.

data.subject: CSV export times out on large datasets
data.body: When we try to export more than 10k rows to CSV, the export just spins forever and eventually times out. We need this for our monthly reporting. Started happening after the last update.

data.subject: New team members can't figure out setup
data.body: We just onboarded 15 new users and most of them couldn't complete the initial setup without help. The wizard skips too many steps and assumes prior knowledge. We ended up writing our own internal guide.

items.label: Enterprise: API rate limits too low

data.subject: API rate limits preventing integration
data.body: We're hitting the 100 req/min rate limit constantly with our automated pipeline. We need at least 500 req/min for our use case. This is blocking our integration with Salesforce. Happy to pay more if needed.

data.subject: Please add dark theme
data.body: Love the product but please add dark mode. Every other tool we use has it and switching to your bright UI is jarring. Some of our devs have started using browser extensions to force dark mode which breaks the layout.

data.subject: SAML SSO setup failing silently
data.body: We've been trying to set up SAML SSO for two weeks. The configuration saves without error but authentication always falls back to password. No error logs, no feedback. Our security team is threatening to block the tool if we can't get SSO working.

data.subject: Mobile app crashes when switching between projects
data.body: Our field team uses the mobile app heavily and it crashes at least 3-4 times a day when they switch between projects. They're losing unsaved work. This started about 2 weeks ago. Android only, iOS seems fine.

data.subject: Need bulk user provisioning
data.body: We're onboarding 500 users next quarter and there's no way to bulk create accounts or assign roles. Doing this one by one through the UI would take weeks. Need SCIM support or at minimum a CSV import for users.
